'''House a'Naloy''' is the present royal house of [[Murandy]]. 

== House members ==
* [[Roedran Almaric do Arreloa a'Naloy]], King of Murandy

== Activities ==
King Roedran wishes to truly unite and cement power under his decentralized kingdom. He considers hiring the [[Band of the Red Hand]] to do so.{{ref/book|8|18}}

The king largely keeps Murandy out of the chaos leading up to the [[Last Battle]], and does not even wish to go to the [[Field of Merrilor]], although he relents in exchange for a formal proclamation from Queen [[Elayne Trakand]] that [[Andor]] will not invade Murandy.{{ref/book|14|5}}
